about: Every painted plate of the story (docs/ART-PLATES.md). src is under public/; size is the image in pixels; depth is the distance behind the picture plane in world units (z = -depth); anchor is the point of the image (fractions from the left and from the top) placed at position (world x, y); height is the plate's height in world units (width follows the image aspect and repeat). The first scene in scenes owns the file's folder; the others reuse it. role: plate (placed in depth), backdrop (fills the view behind the scene), texture (read by a material), sprite (repeated by an effect). Entries with a placeholder spec are drawn by `npm run art:placeholders` (kind `study`: a painted stand-in of a character from scripts/art/cast.mjs); `npm run art:import` replaces the file with a finished painting, deletes the spec and sets `painted: true`. points are named image points (fractions from the left and top) that code ties things to, read through platePoint().
